# Simulation: The Frog on the Lily Pads

## Question 1 (a) code comment

```{r}
#Define function named hop, while input is the initial position, setting up probability of going right as 0.5.
hop <- function(position, p_right = 0.5) {
  #Set up from going either -1 or 1, missing number of trials(size), defined probability going left as 1- 0.5.
  step <- sample(c(-1, 1), prob = c(p_right, 1 - p_right))
  #update the new position
  position + step
  #return function
  return(position)
}
#Testing with calling function hop with value 4 as initial
hop(4)

```

## Question 1 (b) Updating Code
```{r}
  #setting up initial position in the function
hop <- function(position = 4, p_right = 0.5) {
  #Picking random number from -1 or 1 for next direction, and probability of going right is 0.5, with left as 1-0.5=0.5
  step <- sample(c(-1, 1),
                 size =1, 
                 prob = c(1-p_right,p_right))
  #update the new position, name new position as new_position for better tracking
  new_position <- position+ step
  #return function
  return(new_position)
}

hop()
```

## Question 3(b) Repeated games CI Calculations
```{r 3bCI}
#finding 95% CI and Histogram
nbankr <- sum(results_Q3$banks == "right",na.rm = TRUE)
n_total <- length(results_Q3$banks)
p_right_bank <- nbankr/ n_total
#using binomial testing with nbankr as x and ntotal as y
ci<- binom.test(
  x = nbankr,
  n = n_total,
  conf.level = 0.95
)

lower_ci = ci$conf.int[1]
upper_ci = ci$conf.int[2]

c(p_right_bank = p_right_bank, lower_ci = lower_ci, upper_ci = upper_ci)
```

## Question 4(a) Changing the starting pad from 1-7
```{r 4a}
#lets set up value n for startpads from 1-7
n_startpads=1:7
#set up a list for Q4 result for storing the result, or else it wont be recorded
results_Q4= list()
#loop simulate_frogs from n=1 to n=7, and print result after every cycles
for (n in n_startpads){
  results_Q4[[n]] <- simulate_frogs(n_sims = 1000, 
                               start = n)
  print(results_Q4[[n]]$frog_stats)
}


```
## Question 4(b) Plot the proportion of games ending on the right bank against the starting pad.
```{r}
#get result from previous section, store it as the proportion of games ends on the right bank
#make p_right_bank a 7 digit vector for calculations
p_right_bank<- numeric(7)
#take values from hops 1-7, loop it
for (n in 1:7) {
  p_right_bank[n] <- results_Q4[[n]]$frog_stats["p_right_bank"]
}

plot(x = 1:7,
     y = p_right_bank,
     type = "b",
     col = "red",
     main = "Games ends on Right Bank against starting pad 1-7",
     xlab = "Starting Pads",
     ylab = "Proportion of games ending on the right bank")
```
## Question 4(c) Plot the mean number of hops against the starting pad.
```{r}
##make mean_hops a 7 digit vector for calculations
mean_hops <- numeric(7)
#loop again for taking out values
for (n in 1:7) {
  mean_hops[n] <- results_Q4[[n]]$frog_stats["mean_hops"]
}
#plot again
plot(x = 1:7,
     y = mean_hops,
     type = "b",
     col = "red",
     main = "Mean Hops against starting pad 1-7",
     xlab = "Starting Pads",
     ylab = "Mean Hops")

```

## Question 6
```{r 6aCodeComment}
load("data/assess_data_1226.Rdata")
str(mh_data)
sum(duplicated(mh_data$age))

mh_data$high_risk <- mh_data$risk_level == "high"
table(mh_data$high_risk)

boxplot(bs ~ high_risk, data = mh_data)

fit <- glm(high_risk ~ bs + systolic_bp, family = binomial)
summary(fit)
exp(coef(fit))

or_ci <- confint.default(fit)
or_ci
```
